turns.message: Give me all your policy information.
turns.answer:
Returns: unused bikes may be returned within 30 days of delivery with free return shipping; they must be in the original box with all parts and have less than 50 km ridden. Refunds are processed after warehouse inspection, with the outcome confirmed by a support agent; starting a return requires an order number (format CN-1234) and a short reason. Warranty: frames have 5 years of manufacturing-defect coverage for the original owner; forks, wheels, and components have 2 years; Ridge E batteries and motors have 2 years or 500 charge cycles, whichever comes first; crash damage, normal wear, and modifications are excluded, and frame damage or battery problems require inspection—stop riding and contact support. For general care, clean and lube the chain every 200 km or after rain, check tyre pressure weekly, tighten thru-axles to the torque printed on them, and have the bike serviced yearly; for Ridge E, charge indoors at room temperature using the original charger, store the battery at 30–60% if stored over a month, never pressure-wash the motor or battery, and check brake pads every 500 km. Sizing is S for 155–167 cm, M for 167–178 cm, L for 178–189 cm, and XL for 189–200 cm; between sizes, choose smaller for agility or larger for stability, and Metro C is available only in S, M, and L.

Sources: returns_policy_2026.md, care_general.md, warranty.md, care_ridge_e.md, sizing_guide.md

turns.message: whats your return policy? how many days do i get and do i have to pay to ship it back
turns.answer:
You can return an unused bike within 30 days of delivery, provided it’s in the original box with all parts and has been ridden less than 50 km. Return shipping is free; Ferro Cycles provides a prepaid label and arranges pickup.

Sources: returns_policy_2026.md
